name: plan
description: Turns one approved spec into a master plan plus one self-contained file per phase, each step naming an exact path, a prose action, the skills to load, and a verification command. Phases are tagged with their repo and dependencies so the orchestrator can parallelize. Spawn once after spec approval, when work must be sequenced across files, modules, or repos. Reads the spec and nothing else. Read-only on project source.
